title: Gold futures decline to ₹1,63,109/10gm - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Globally, gold futures declined by 0.23 per cent to $4,641.42 per ounce in New York. | Photo Credit: istock.com

Gold prices on Tuesday dropped by Rs 120 to Rs 1,63,109 per 10 grams in futures trade amid a fall in spot demand.

On the Multi Commodity Exchange, yellow metal contracts for October delivery traded lower by Rs 120, or 0.07 per cent, at Rs 1,63,109 per 10 grams in a business turnover of 1,595 lots.

Gold Rate Today, Aug 25: Gold prices up in Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Ahmedabad

Analysts attributed the decline in precious metal prices to weaker spot demand.

Globally, gold futures declined by 0.23 per cent to USD 4,641.42 per ounce in New York.
